environment.description: Go WebSocket service deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2), running as root, exposed directly on port 8080 via Network Load Balancer (NLB) with TCP passthrough. No API gateway or request inspection in the path. The NLB forwards raw TCP to the instance. Container runs with full filesystem access. Security group allows inbound 8080 from 0.0.0.0/0.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB, TCP passthrough on port 8080
config.filesystem: unrestricted, no chroot or read-only mounts
